text:
Riley: urgent fashion update: Mochi discovered the holiday sweater and immediately declared a pillow-fort runway. photo: https://img.internal/mochi-sweater-fort.jpg :dog: :sweater: :couch: 
June: his expression is 'i accept your applause' and also 'where are the treats'. :clap: :eyes: 
Sam: someone make this a calendar event. mandatory viewing. 
Nora: vote: which runway walk soundtrack? Options: dramatic violin / elevator pop / canned applause. 
Riley: dramatic violin pls. GIF: https://img.internal/mochi-strut.gif 
June: also note: Mochi only models one paw out of the fort at a time. very coy. 
Sam: reaction: :heart: (to the first pic) 
Nora: asked: does Mochi allow photography rights for mugs? asking for merch. 
Riley: he will accept a small fee in peanut butter. non-negotiable. 
ops-bot: Reminder: studio-level props (lamps, rugs) should be secured if used in common spaces. register props with Facilities. :bulb: 
June: added a close-up: https://img.internal/mochi-peak.jpg tiny snoot 
Sam: I will never be over the tiny sweater sleeve. makes me emotional. 
Nora: poll: Bring props + pets to virtual show-and-tell next Friday? Options: Yes / No / Virtual only. 
Riley: voted Yes. 
June: voted Virtual only (my dog eats pillows). 
Sam: voted Yes. 
Nora: voted Yes. 
Riley: parting note: Mochi fell asleep mid-curtsy and drooled on the pillow. high couture, low effort.
